date_time_rules.plan_and_task_date: DATE stores the calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) in Asia/Seoul, without timezone conversion
date_time_rules.timestamps: TIMESTAMPTZ stores an absolute instant; submitted datetime-local values are parsed with explicit +09:00 (Asia/Seoul)
date_time_rules.overdue_rule: task status != completed AND due_date < current Seoul-local calendar date
date_time_rules.duration_unit: integer minutes, computed in database by ROUND((ended_at-started_at) seconds / 60)
date_time_rules.planned_task_time_slot: local TIME HH:MM with no UTC conversion; optional pair, when selected start < end on the same due_date
date_time_rules.estimate_optional: null = not enabled; zero = enabled without a number; sum treats null as additive identity only

fields.title: text
fields.estimated_minutes: integer minutes|null (null = estimate not applicable, 0 = enabled and blank/zero)

plans.behavior: soft delete: deleted_at non-null hides plan and its related records from live GET; export retains historical records

plan_revisions.behavior: AFTER INSERT/UPDATE trigger automatically appends immutable historical snapshot

fields.title: text
fields.start_time: time HH:MM|null (Asia/Seoul, planned clock time, not a work session)
fields.end_time: time HH:MM|null (required with start_time; same-day end > start)

tasks.behavior: soft delete: deleted_at is non-null; excluded from all live aggregates; NULL estimated_minutes and NULL start/end_time are legitimate disabled settings; stored values survive refresh

completion_events.behavior: one immutable event per task: DB-level unique constraints plus atomic UPDATE/INSERT CTE prevent duplicate event from rapid repeat requests; status is counted from tasks, not events

aggregates.scope: live tasks for selected plan (deleted_at IS NULL)
aggregates.completed: number of scoped tasks currently having status = completed
aggregates.overdue: number of scoped incomplete tasks with due_date earlier than today's Seoul date
aggregates.blocked: number of distinct scoped tasks with >=1 nonblank blocked_reason work_session
aggregates.estimated: sum(non-null tasks.estimated_minutes) for scoped tasks; returns 0 if all are NULL or empty; NULL is never shown as an individual 0 minute estimate

security.database_secret: DATABASE_URL only on server runtime; never use NEXT_PUBLIC_
security.rendering: React escaped text nodes; do not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML
